scope: private immutable client-response authentication wall cost, no replay-admission/socket/CPU50 claim
criterion: =0.5.1 default-features=false, temporary hosted dev dependency only

fallback.query: last-slot original Observe reference after two downloads, latest fails authentication

first_slot_guard: Reuse full normal fixture and query only slot0; same path as a single occupied first slot, preventing aggregate gains masking constrained-path regression.

decision.normal_entry: relative mean<=-0.02 and upper95CI<0 in both rounds
decision.other: all source/binary/lock identities and full authentication checks must pass; otherwise STOP inconclusive/reject, no more variants/replacement runs

ratio_orientation: Criterion reports second/first minus1; round2 invert ratio and reverse/invert bounds to express candidate/baseline.
runtime: same test executable and host; pin benchmark child to one allowed CPU, no background disk sampling during measurement; capture affinity/compiler/features/flags
